% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Build status: \wcTpBadge*[variant=success,pulse]{Ready}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/badge/badge.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("p");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  Build status: "));

const element2 = document.createElement("tp-badge");
element2.setAttribute("variant", "success");
element2.setAttribute("pulse", "");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("Ready"));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example With icon
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBadge[outlined]{\wcTpIcon*[name=file_type_vite,library=languages]{} Vite\wcTpDivider*[orientation=vertical]{}8.1.5}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Status labels
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpBadge[variant=success]{Complete}

\wcTpBadge[variant=warning]{Pending}
\end{document}
